question: Let $A=[a_{ij}]_{3\times 2}$, where $a_{ij}=2i-3j$. Construct the matrix $A$ and hence find $a_{31}+a_{22}$.
explanation:
Evaluation of entries
Using $a_{ij}=2i-3j$, we get $a_{11}=-1$, $a_{12}=-4$, $a_{21}=1$, $a_{22}=-2$, $a_{31}=3$ and $a_{32}=0$.
Matrix in $[a_{ij}]$ notation
$$A=\begin{bmatrix}-1 & -4 \\ 1 & -2 \\ 3 & 0\end{bmatrix}$$
Required value
$$a_{31}+a_{22}=3+(-2)=1$$
